owner: Inner Cosmos Psychology Capability Working Group

title.zh-CN: 记下什么支持真的有用
title.en-SG: Map the support that actually helps

description.zh-CN: 分清安慰、建议、陪伴和信息各自对你的作用，帮你说清楚想要的支持。
description.en-SG: Tell apart comfort, advice, company and information, so you can ask for the kind of support that fits you.

evidence: Rosenberg 2003, Nonviolent Communication: A Language of Life

limitations.zh-CN: 支持偏好会随情境和关系变化；这不是依恋类型或关系质量测评，结果也不会自动分享给任何人。证据出处与文案待心理专家复核（CP-60A 双专家门禁）。
limitations.en-SG: Support preferences change across situations and relationships; this is not an attachment-style or relationship-quality assessment, and the result is never shared with anyone automatically. Evidence citations and wording await psychology expert review (CP-60A dual-expert gate).
